projectContext: Sprint 35 focuses on architecture improvements: (1) Mullvad VPN activation in the default pipeline flow, (2) Download system architectural enhancements, (3) Documentation of the 4-tier escalation architecture. Key files: src/pipeline.py, src/downloader/escalation_manager.py, src/downloader/mullvad_vpn.py, src/downloader/core.py, CLAUDE.md, README.md.

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for architecture focus area
userStories.notes: Meta-story for sprint generation. Sprint 35 focuses on architecture improvements around Mullvad VPN pipeline integration, download system enhancements, and documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/ralph-config.json to understand focus areas
Analyze codebase to find 8-12 specific architecture improvements
Add stories US-35-002 through US-35-012 to sprint.json
Each story has 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story has notes with tier classification and source file paths

userStories.title: Auto-activate Mullvad VPN in create_healing_pipeline
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Medium). Implemented auto-activation of MullvadVPN in create_healing_pipeline() when config.download.mullvad.enabled=true. Added set_mullvad_vpn() method to HealingOrchestrator to store the instance, and wire_escalation_manager() now also wires MullvadVPN to EscalationManager. Added 7 tests in tests/test_pipeline_orchestrator.py. Files modified: src/pipeline.py (lines 652-667), src/agents/orchestrator.py (lines 121, 1003-1021).
acceptanceCriteria: Update create_healing_pipeline() to instantiate MullvadVPN when config.download.mullvad.enabled is true
Wire MullvadVPN into EscalationManager via set_mullvad_vpn() method
Add debug logging when Mullvad auto-activation occurs
Add test in tests/test_pipeline_orchestrator.py verifying MullvadVPN is wired when enabled
Run pytest tests/test_pipeline_orchestrator.py -v --tb=short to verify

userStories.title: Add MullvadVPN factory method to EscalationManager
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Medium). Added EscalationManager.create_with_mullvad() factory method that instantiates both EscalationManager and MullvadVPN (if enabled), wiring them together automatically. Added 5 tests in TestCreateWithMullvad class. Files modified: src/downloader/escalation_manager.py (added create_with_mullvad classmethod at lines 821-873), tests/test_escalation_manager.py (added TestCreateWithMullvad test class).
acceptanceCriteria: Add EscalationManager.create_with_mullvad(config, impersonation_manager, mullvad_config) class method
Factory method instantiates MullvadVPN from MullvadConfig if enabled
Factory method calls set_mullvad_vpn() internally to wire VPN
Add test verifying factory method creates properly configured EscalationManager
Run python -m py_compile src/downloader/escalation_manager.py to verify syntax

Include current_country and used_countries list in escalation metrics

userStories.title: Document 4-tier escalation architecture in README.md
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (Quick Win). README.md lacks documentation of the 4-tier escalation system (Impersonate → Extractor-args → Cookie rotation → VPN rotation). CLAUDE.md has this info but README needs user-facing docs. Source files: README.md, CLAUDE.md (lines 110-150 have escalation overview).

Document 4-tier escalation chain with brief description of each tier
Include ASCII diagram or table showing escalation flow
Add config.yaml snippet showing how to enable Mullvad VPN
Verify section exists with grep -A 20 'Download Resilience' README.md

userStories.title: Add VPN status endpoint to HealingOrchestrator
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Medium). HealingOrchestrator.print_report() doesn't include VPN status. Add method to expose VPN status for the healing report. Source files: src/agents/orchestrator.py (HealingOrchestrator class), src/pipeline.py (lines 732-740, orchestrator.print_report call).
acceptanceCriteria: Add get_vpn_status() method to HealingOrchestrator that returns MullvadVPN status if available
Update print_report() to include VPN rotation count and current country

userStories.title: Add circuit breaker reset on VPN rotation
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Medium). When VPN rotates to new IP, circuit breaker should reset since new IP has fresh rate limit budget. Currently no integration between MullvadVPN.rotate_server() and CircuitBreaker.reset(). Source files: src/downloader/mullvad_vpn.py (lines 156-236, rotate_server method), src/downloader/circuit_breaker.py (CircuitBreaker.reset method).
acceptanceCriteria: Add optional circuit_breaker parameter to MullvadVPN.rotate_server() method
Call circuit_breaker.reset() after successful VPN rotation
Add logging when circuit breaker is reset due to VPN rotation
Add test verifying circuit breaker reset on VPN rotation
Run pytest tests/test_download*.py tests/test_escalation*.py -v --tb=short to verify

userStories.title: Add VPN rotation trigger to EscalationManager.record_failure
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Medium). When EscalationManager escalates to Tier 4, it sets rotate_vpn=True flag but doesn't actually trigger rotation. Caller must handle. Add optional callback pattern. Source files: src/downloader/escalation_manager.py (lines 397-476, record_failure method), src/downloader/core.py (download handling).
acceptanceCriteria: Add on_vpn_rotation_needed callback parameter to EscalationManager.__init__
Call callback when escalating to Tier 4 (VPN_ROTATION)
Callback receives keyword string for context logging
Add test verifying callback invocation on Tier 4 escalation
Run pytest tests/test_escalation*.py -v --tb=short to verify

userStories.title: Add Mullvad CLI availability check at startup
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (Quick Win). MullvadVPN methods catch FileNotFoundError when mullvad CLI is missing but no upfront check exists. Add is_available() class method. Source files: src/downloader/mullvad_vpn.py (lines 107-109, FileNotFoundError catch), src/downloader/vpn_manager.py (base class).
acceptanceCriteria: Add MullvadVPN.is_available() static method that checks if mullvad CLI exists

Add warning log if Mullvad config is enabled but CLI not available
Update create_healing_pipeline to check is_available() before instantiating

Source files: src/downloader/mullvad_vpn.py (lines 238-259, _pick_next_country method), src/config/sections/download.py (MullvadConfig dataclass).
acceptanceCriteria: Update _pick_next_country to use self.config.preferred_countries if available

userStories.title: Add max_rotations_per_session to MullvadVPN
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (Medium). MullvadVPN has no limit on rotations per session. Add max_rotations from config to prevent infinite rotation loops. Source files: src/downloader/mullvad_vpn.py (lines 156-236, rotate_server method), src/downloader/vpn_manager.py (VPNManager base class).
acceptanceCriteria: Add _max_rotations field to MullvadVPN initialized from config.max_rotations_per_session
Update rotate_server() to return False if _switch_count >= _max_rotations
Log warning when max rotations reached
Add test verifying rotation stops at max_rotations limit

acceptanceCriteria: Add _last_rotation_time field to MullvadVPN
Check rotation_delay_seconds cooldown before allowing rotation
Return False and log if rotation attempted during cooldown
